quest.title: Sightseeing With Friends: Scenic Highlights
quest.description: Paimon seems to have her own thoughts about sightseeing and photo spots in Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, next up is a special route Paimon picked out after really careful planning! We'll be walking for a while, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: First stop, the desert oasis! Then we'll head through Mawtiyima Forest, and after that, back to Bayda Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been thinking about this... The desert, forest, and valleys in Sumeru all feel super different! But we've pretty much never seen them all in one trip, have we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good thing we don't have to rush this time. Paimon says we should take it nice and slow and soak it all in!

choices.text: Sure thing! No rush, just vibes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, our Fungi friends look ready and raring to go! Let's hit the road!

choices.text: Yup! Outings are meant to be nice and chill.
